counter.rd_command: one mem[a]256bit word queued per RD; one queued record returned per PC/HCLK
counter.burst: BURST=1024ps is timing span; no data multiplicity

tile_residency.address_contract: lk/lv and kvw_addr map position/head/dimension only; no layer-select bits or per-layer valid/tag directory
tile_residency.mapped_window: one current layer; next fill overwrites same addresses after kv_free
tile_residency.numeric_provider_backing: 144MiB/rank preloaded once outside tiles; not on-tile multi-layer residency

prefetch.rm_next_layer: L1..L35, then255 for head; no L0 next-token notice during head
prefetch.release_gate: early_go requires kv_free/free_seen + fill_done + wb_issued_all + posted descriptor + no outstanding token/start/descriptor hazard
prefetch.on_early_go: increment gen; lyr=posted; nfill=n_of(posted_p); clear ALL lcnt; fill_done=0; clear tail/assembly
prefetch.on_normal_start: increment gen; nfill=n_of(pos); clear ALL lcnt; fill_done=ideal only; no cache-hit test
prefetch.on_prefilled_start: reuse only same pre_lyr/pre_p next-layer fill context; no second refill for that same layer
prefetch.overlap_scope: next fill can overlap remaining current-layer MLP; it remains mandatory traffic
prefetch.steady_semantics: for subsequent supported8K-shape decode each layer is refilled after other layers overwrite its addresses; no delta-only/cache-resident36 path
prefetch.pos_limit: selected descriptor map faults at pos>=8192; no second token at P8192 is claimed

conclusion: Four protected return links cannot support ~162us per token for mandatory all36 exact8K KV reload. 983.04us is payload-only source-capacity floor, not just cold-start tax; overlap cannot remove steady bytes/token.
method: actual bound RTL/driver semantics and arithmetic only; no new pricing model, hardware, run, sweep or clock waiver
